abstract: Covers the W3C TDM Reservation Protocol (TDMRep), pinned to the Final Community Group Report of 10 May 2024: the tdm-reservation and tdm-policy properties, the /.well-known/tdmrep.json file, HTTP headers, HTML meta and EPUB/PDF metadata, processing priority, and the ODRL 2.2 TDM Policy profile. The Final Report is the only line; the editor's draft is tracked as a source. SKILL.md holds the invariants and workflow; references split out versions, declaring and applying reservations, and TDM Policies.
